completionPolicy.requires: All visible required core/branch choices and required text fields

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.intro
elements.html:
Write and test a brief with a task, relevant context, limits and output format.

A prompt is an instruction and context you give a system. A useful brief makes the task inspectable: what should be done, for whom, with which limits, and in what format? A role such as “expert” may change style but does not give the model new evidence or qualifications. Better wording can help; it cannot guarantee truth. Test the result against your brief and keep responsibility for the decision.

Practice scenario

You need a notice for a fictional free book swap: Tuesday, library, 15:30–16:00. No refreshments are promised.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.brief
elements.title: Which prompt makes success easiest to check?

choices.text: Act as the world’s best organizer. Be perfect.
Draft a 40-word notice using only Tuesday, library, 15:30–16:00, free book swap; do not invent extras.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.brief.feedback.magic
elements.html: There are no checkable facts or limits here.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.brief.feedback.specific
elements.html: Clear facts and limits make review easier, though you still must inspect it.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.brief.feedback.long
elements.html: Length is not the goal.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.check
elements.title: The draft adds free pizza. What next?

choices.text: Keep it because it sounds inviting.
Remove the unsupported promise and compare every fact with the brief.
Add “expert” and trust the next draft unseen.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.check.feedback.remove
elements.html: Correct the output using the supplied facts.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.check.feedback.role
elements.html: A role is not a factual check.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.transfer
elements.title: Write your own brief for the book swap, then name two checks you would apply to any draft.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l04.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Includes all supplied event facts without new promises.
  • States audience or format.
  • Names two observable checks.

Prompt patterns vary across models; no universal magic phrase is taught.
